title: AI system scores HER2 immunohistochemistry and filters DCIS in breast cancer slides
summary: An AI system uses calponin staining to identify and filter ductal carcinoma in situ, then scores HER2 immunohistochemistry (0, 1+, 2+, 3+) on whole-slide images. In a two-phase reader study on 112 slides with a 2-week washout, pathologist accuracy rose from 0.710 to 0.902 with AI, and HER2 1+ cases misread as 0 fell from 65/279 to 32/279. Intra-class correlation also improved, most among junior pathologists. The same slides and readers were used in both phases.
ai_technology: AI models for DCIS filtering (calponin staining) and HER2 whole-slide image scoring
organization: Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University
